notes.title: Whoa, Already!?
notes.notes:
[p]Hello there!
[/p][p]We're thrilled to announce that SoundCat is officially live on Steam! 
But this is just the beginning, we'll be rolling out updates regularly with new features and improvements.  [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45644161/0c57fa8257fefea70ade0f9dc00b3ba6471330a3.png"][/img]
To celebrate launch, SoundCat is 20% off for a limited time! Not sure yet? Try the free demo and see what you think!

The demo will remain available as a free introduction to SoundCat. It includes limited features and a cap on how many sounds you can use, perfect for testing things out before you dive into the full version.[/p][p]   [/p][p][i]- Spooky Labs <3[/i][/p]
